data.687502c4660d147e2502a94f Description: A simple disk with a handwritten note that this is the second version, the final one. Finally you can go through the whole game all the way to the end. Gotta write a review later!
data.69bb42b9ce2b96840302b92b Description: The control log of a nuclear power unit records safety parameters, routine inspection results, and various measurements ensuring the safe operation of the Icebreaker’s nuclear reactor.
data.67bde1dc5678472f2a0e6167 Description: A flash drive found at the abandoned high-ranking TerraGroup staff's SUV. Contains something important, though it's unclear what exactly.
data.67bde22566ca1d79a202462f Description: A flight recorder found at the plane that crashed in the Priozersk nature reserve. This device is crucial to figuring out what happened to the plane.
data.67bde548cf0cc29475092192 Description: A flash drive Elektronik used to write the crashed plane crew's conversations. A very valuable piece of intel.
data.689b4d39987b304021088e8d Description: A printout of the transcript from the pilots of the downed aircraft.
data.67bde59edb4b617a6c0d69f8 Description: A mysterious briefcase, apparently containing a certain "Ticket" out of Tarkov.
data.67bdea3ecf0cc29475092196 Description: A device developed by TerraGroup, capable of suppressing digital signals within a 100 meter radius.
data.67bdf097600629c8f20322e5 Description: A pass card that used to grant access to all doors within the system. Used exclusively inside TerraGroup laboratories. No longer operational.
data.67c0324acc87f341720274b6 Description: A device capable of encrypting RFID card data. Features an integrated microcontroller. Commonly used within TerraGroup facilities.
data.68ea992027da8dde060ebfef Description: A note left in the pumping station containing instructions for the maintenance crew.
